hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol. Holds the afterInitialize permission but performs no action in it; a separate initializePools() function calls an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper to seed initial liquidity and records the initial tick. Does not modify swap, add-liquidity, or remove-liquidity behavior.
